risks.title: Adverse Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to economic risks, notably recession, which could lead to tenant defaults and prolonged vacancies. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Inflation and Rising Interest Rates
risks.score_rationale: Inflation and elevated interest rates may increase the company's financing and operating costs. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Tenant Competition and Re-leasing Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may need to provide concessions or reduced rates for re-leasing, which could result in rent declines and vacancies. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Tenant Default Risk
risks.score_rationale: Tenant defaults could have a significant impact on the company's revenues and financial position. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Capital Market Access and Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Adverse credit market conditions may restrict operating activities and the company's ability to access financing. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Real Estate Market and Property Value Risk
risks.score_rationale: Variations in real estate market conditions could affect property values and appreciation prospects. (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: STAG mentioned artificial intelligence in its 10-K report as one of the macro-economic factors affecting the industrial real estate sector (Item 7, MD&A), but without detailing a specific AI integration strategy in its operations.
